blind.description: A stylised dark wooden coffin with its lid partially slid down to reveal the open interior. The coffin has a classic hexagonal shape with dark brown wood plank texture and metal ring handles along the sides. The lid is detailed with raised wooden battens and metal studs along its perimeter. Inside, a padded white/beige fabric rim lines the cavity. Surfaces are solid and well-defined with clean geometry and hand-painted style texturing.
blind.from_above: An elongated hexagonal shape with the wooden lid covering roughly two-thirds of the length, shifted slightly to the side to expose the deep dark interior lined with pale fabric at the lower end; one metal ring handle extends to the left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 ft tall (reaching around calf height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 4.5 ft long, and about 1.8 ft wide across its widest point.
